components.name: Project context
components.description: Editable project notes sit above the separate rolling conversation summary, with privacy and correction guidance.
components.html:
Project context

Keep the details you want every conversation to remember.

These notes stay until you edit them. Your chat and notes are private.

Conversation summary

As you chat, a summary of your decisions and open questions will appear here.

Updated after each reply. To correct a detail, tell us in chat or pin it in your project notes.

narrative.northStar: The GALX workspace and its page canvas
narrative.overview:
This is a scoped extension of the incumbent [GALXAI design system](../../../DESIGN.md). Its authority is limited to the Sites component family, the `/sites` routes, and their linked [page preview renderer](../../lib/sites/site-preview.ts). The existing application navigation and global identity retain their own design authority.

The interface uses compact dark panels, clear text, restrained indigo actions and thin separators. A warm light page canvas gives the authored content a separate reading surface. This material distinction is already built; it does not establish a new palette for other GALX screens.
keyCharacteristics: Compact dark controls with visible indigo interaction states.
Conversation and authored page remain visually distinct.
Continuing conversations, project notes and version history share one quiet panel system.
Serif page headings sit inside the preview; workspace headings use Inter.
Loading, saved, unavailable and publication feedback remain readable in either mobile panel.

rules.name: The Canvas Boundary Rule
rules.body: Paper and green ink identify authored content; workspace controls remain in the incumbent dark palette.

rules.name: The Labeled State Rule
rules.body: Color never carries draft, live, pending or error meaning without readable text.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Inter belongs to the authoring controls; the serif hierarchy belongs to the authored page.

rules.name: The Quiet Depth Rule
rules.body: Use borders and tone for interface grouping; reserve the soft canvas shadow for the page preview.

rules.name: The Draft Continuity Rule
rules.body: Preserve the selected Site's unsent message, mode and reading position when replies or view changes do not require replacing them. First visits and empty Sites show the welcome at the top; New Site resets that orientation and clears stale unread indicators and earlier-history scroll anchors. Only an existing conversation or pending reply follows the bottom, subject to the reader's position.

rules.name: The Version Clarity Rule
rules.body: Label historical previews explicitly, keep a visible path to the current draft, and confirm restoration as a new draft before applying it.

dos: **Do** preserve the existing GALX shell and indigo controls around the page canvas.
**Do** keep authored-page paper and green ink inside the preview and its related content representations.
**Do** preserve the left-conversation/right-preview arrangement on desktop and explicit panel switching on mobile.
**Do** retain per-Site drafts and modes, respect the reader's scroll position, and offer a visible return to the latest message.
**Do** start empty Sites at the top with the welcome visible and reset that orientation on New Site, keeping the composer below the conversation.
**Do** distinguish editable project notes, the rolling conversation summary and saved page versions with clear labels.
**Do** match historical preview labels and downloads to the selected version, and explain that restore creates a new draft while publication stays unchanged.
**Do** pair statuses with text, keep feedback visible in both mobile views, and distinguish loading from example content.
**Do** preserve visible focus, keyboard access to conversation and history, mobile touch targets and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: **Don't** turn the page template's serif typography or light palette into global workspace defaults.
**Don't** treat a preview, saved draft or queued address as evidence that a page is publicly live.
**Don't** use a generic completion message in place of the actual turn reply or imply that Discuss changes the draft.
**Don't** add decorative kickers, glyph icons or hard block shadows to this workspace.
**Don't** generalize local palette differences into detector exclusions for unrelated files.
